notes: The PDF now has the same pages as the preview. The printed copy breaks exactly where the preview shows a new page, and the preview leaves a few millimetres spare on each page, because browsers lay text out slightly differently on paper (fonts, zoom and operating system all play a part). Before, a CV that showed two pages could print on three. Some CVs that only just fitted will now show an extra page in the preview; that is what would have printed.
